xBRIEFInfo.description: Project definition for the fictional Northstar Directive capstone

narratives.Overview: A fictional disposable no-remote repository for rehearsing one complete evidence-driven Directive change.
narratives.Product: A tiny immutable work-items library and CLI whose supplied tests define the learner's bounded implementation task.
narratives.Audience: 3Ci Directive learners completing the solo end-to-end capstone.
narratives.SourceOfTruth: The active xBRIEF owns the one-file product scope; immutable fixture gates remain in the repository and stage evidence remains outside it.
narratives.DevelopmentPosture: Private pre-release training fixture with no compatibility layer.
narratives.ProjectRules: Use fictional data only. Keep every mutation inside the unique operating-system temporary repository. After readiness, change only src/work-items.mjs and preserve tests, gates, scope, helpers, branch, and the empty remote set. Do not push, open a pull request, merge, deploy, publish, or release.
